turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
s it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu
Orders placed before 12:00 PM EST (Monday through Friday) are processed and shipped the same day. Orders placed after 12:00 PM EST, or on weekends and holidays, are processed and shipped the following business day.
Once your order ships, tracking details are sent out right away. Please note that on rare occasions when an item is out of stock, processing can take up to 7 business days to ship.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
